final: WITH per_telescope AS (SELECT telescref, AVG(modindex) AS avg_modindex FROM signals WHERE modindex IS NOT NULL GROUP BY telescref), above AS (SELECT telescref, avg_modindex FROM per_telescope WHERE avg_modindex > (SELECT AVG(avg_modindex) FROM per_telescope)), stats AS (SELECT AVG(avg_modindex) AS above_avg FROM above) SELECT a.telescref, a.avg_modindex, a.avg_modindex - (SELECT AVG(avg_modindex) FROM per_telescope) AS above_overall, a.avg_modindex / s.above_avg AS ratio FROM above AS a CROSS JOIN stats AS s ORDER BY ratio DESC LIMIT 10
